title: The Unwritten Typewriter
author: Emrys Nystrom
blurb: Juniper Ashgrove, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
